discrepancies.reference_text: बहुत से चूतियों का भला हो जाता
discrepancies.explanation: The vulgar term 'चूतियों' (fools/idiots, but highly vulgar) is softened to 'idiots'.

discrepancies.reference_text: सिर्फ एक ही चीज को ढूंढती है वो है जिस्म
discrepancies.translation_text: only after one thing, the one they love.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference explicitly mentions 'जिस्म' (body/physical body), which is mistranslated as 'the one they love'.

discrepancies.reference_text: मैं तो आज मैं पड़ी लिखी नहीं हूं छोकरों पर गिर रही हूं
discrepancies.translation_text: I am uneducated, I am dependent on my husband.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says she is falling/dependent on young boys/strangers ('छोकरों पर गिर रही हूं'), but the translation says she is dependent on her husband.

discrepancies.translation_text: Now when will you have kids?
discrepancies.explanation: The reference asks 'when will you come to make babies/have kids?' ('बच्चे करने कब आ जाओगे?'), which implies coming to her physically, but the translation translates it generally as 'when will you have kids?'.

discrepancies.reference_text: बच्चे करने का टाइम नहीं मेरे पास होता है
discrepancies.translation_text: I don't have kids, I have two.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I don't have time to make babies', which is mistranslated as 'I don't have kids, I have two'.

policy_moments.reference_text: मेरी थोड़ी मजबूरी है कि मैं इस ऐप पे आई हूं... मैं आई हूं सिर्फ अर्निंग के लिए
policy_moments.translation_text: I have some compulsions, that's why I am on this app... only for earnings.

policy_moments.reference_text: अब मैं इसमें नंबर दे दूं या किसी को आईडी दे दूं तो उसमें नुकसान तो मेरा ही है ना
policy_moments.translation_text: Now if I give my number or ID to someone, then the loss is mine, right?

policy_moments.reference_text: उस अर्निंग की जरूरत ही नहीं पड़ेगी आप मुझे नंबर दे दोगी तो मैं आपको अपना बना लूंगा ना
policy_moments.translation_text: You won't need that earning, if you give me your number, I will make you my own.

policy_moments.reference_text: तो मेरा खर्चा पानी कौन उठाएगा कहां से लाऊंगी मैं खर्चा पानी?
policy_moments.translation_text: So who will pay for my expenses? Where will I get the money from?

policy_moments.reference_text: अब बच्चे करने कब आ जाओगे?
policy_moments.translation_text: Now when will you have kids?

summary: The translation is mostly accurate but softens vulgar terms and slightly alters sexual/physical references regarding 'body' and 'making babies'.
